verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed law firm offering attorney-delivered legal services such as fintech regulatory, venture, IP and privacy work. It is not a software product with a UI whose functions could be mirrored through an API, so API–UI parity is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The evidence shows no software API or UI, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
